prompt: An L-shape has outer dimensions $6 \times 4$. The inner cut is $2 \times 2$. Find the perimeter.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Sketch the shape and label every length. A 30-second drawing saves 5 minutes of thinking.

explanation: Outer L-shape perimeter sums to $20$ when you walk along all edges.
